rawContent: @SecDef Listening to Secretary Austin speak is so influencing to hear & to watch. The image of Defense Secretary LLoyd Austin is extremely necessary & motivating for our Black & Brown children. Thank you Secretary Austin!🖤 #BlackLivesMatter
